apps.synth_demo.description.en: Hold 1-5 to sustain each waveform; ENTER/6/7/8 play test songs, 9 plays a real MIDI file -- exercises the synth package's real-time note_on/note_off engine and the midi package's file parser, with a live oscilloscope/level-meter visualizer.
